terms.title: Injongo
terms.body: Olu xwebhu lubonisa isakhiwo esisezantsi seAWA ⁇ s.

terms.title: Ukusetyenziswa kwesicelo
terms.body: I-AWA inika izixhobo zokulandelela abantu kunye nolonwabo. Umxholo wokugqibela ochaza amalungelo neembopheleleko zabasebenzisi ⁇  uza kongezelelwa xa kugqitywe ukuqinisekiswa ngokusemthethweni.

terms.title: Ukufumaneka kwenkonzo
terms.body: Imiqathango yokugqibela elawula ukufumaneka, ulondolozo kunye nokuvela kwenkonzo isamele iqinisekiswe.

terms.title: Unxibelelwano
terms.body: Iinkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano ezisemthethweni ziya kongezelelwa xa sele zilungiselelwe yiqela leAWA.

privacy.title: Idatha echaphazelekayo
privacy.body: Eli candelo liya kuchaza ngokuchanekileyo idatha eqhutywa yi-AWA kunye nenjongo yayo, xa sele igqityiwe ukuqinisekiswa ngokusemthethweni.

privacy.title: Ukugcinwa nokhuseleko
privacy.body: Uxwebhu lokugqibela luya kuchaza amanyathelo okugcina, ukhuseleko kunye nexesha lokugcina.

privacy.title: Amalungelo akho
privacy.body: Iinkqubo zokufikelela, ukulungisa okanye ukucima idatha yakho ziya kuchazwa kwiinguqulelo eziqinisekisiweyo.

privacy.title: Ukudibana nobomi
privacy.body: Idilesi yokunxibelelana esemthethweni yomphathi wobumfihlo iya kufakwa ngaphambi kokupapashwa.

Umzekeliso: ibhinqa elisesithendeni elincamathelayo kumatrasi weyoga.
